description: Renovate runs from the CENTRAL workflow in the infra repo (.github/workflows/renovate.yml) — there is no renovate.yml in this repo. This file says only WHAT to update here; the runner, its schedule and RENOVATE_TOKEN live there. Removing this repo from RENOVATE_REPOSITORIES in that workflow silently stops all updates here.

Division of labour with the security stack: Trivy Operator scans the image this repo builds once it is RUNNING on the cluster, including base-OS CVEs. Renovate covers the source side Trivy structurally cannot see — the workflow supply chain, and base images before they ship.
Default branch here is master, not main. Renovate targets the default branch automatically — do not add baseBranches unless that changes.

packageRules.description: Pin GitHub Actions to a commit SHA, matching the convention in the infra repo. Actions never become a running container image, so Trivy never sees them, yet they execute with this repo's token and registry credentials.

Base images get their OWN PR, never grouped. A Python minor bump is a judgement call rather than a routine patch, and multi-stage builder/runtime stages must move together or the build breaks in a way CI catches late.
